summary: Drive revenue and customer success by advising customers on Autodesk Construction Cloud product integrations, master technical messaging on APIs, and implement integrations.
responsibilities: Partner with Sales on key accounts to drive revenue with technical messaging and clear value propositions for partner-built and custom integrations
Work with product and engineering leadership to analyze customers' technical product requirements and assist in driving prioritization of API enhancements.
Support sales productivity and deal flow by securing the 'technical win'
Provide coaching, professional development, and enablement to Sales, Consulting, and Partners to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills
Onboard and provide ongoing support to customers and software partners that use the ACC Connect platform
required_skills: 3+ years of sales engineering or technical implementation experience in a SaaS organization
Excellent communication skills, both with customers and within an organization
Consistent track record of successfully overcoming customers' technical challenges
Experience defining, mapping, developing, and implementing critical document and data workflows for customers
Technical knowledge of REST APIs and ability to write basic scripts utilizing integration platforms
Ability to help customers troubleshoot code written in languages such as JavaScript, Ruby, Python, Java, and C++/.NET
nice_to_have_skills: Experience working with Integration Platforms as a Service (iPaaS) such as Workato, Mulesoft, Boomi, Zapier, or Tray.io
Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or other construction technology platforms
Hands-on experience designing and deploying API-based integrations across cloud SaaS applications
Working knowledge of OAuth, webhooks, and common authentication/authorization frameworks
Experience collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams in a pre-sales or post-sales environment
Ability to create or maintain technical documentation, playbooks, and customer-facing enablement material
Strong problem-solving skills with experience debugging integrations, APIs, and data workflows
